snippet.title: INKY’s SLEEP | Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
"Step into Inky’s sleep - a haunting yet enchanting 2D horror-adventure with surreal touches, led by an endearing little cat. Explore dark dreams, unravel uncanny puzzles, and evade otherworldly creatures."

🐈 STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3996640/Inkys_Sleep/

🐈 DEMO on itch.io - https://tripglyph.itch.io/inkys-sleep-demo

📺 The game is being developed by me, Tim Larick.
🎹 Music themes composed by Stewart Keller: https://stewartkeller.bandcamp.com/
